question: Did WebKit app open regress between H1 and now (target-feasibility.json suggested about 1 s)?
method: Production builds (vite build + vite preview) of each checkpoint from git worktrees sharing the unchanged lockfile; iPhone 13 WebKit; 6 fresh contexts in one browser: goto / until Crea il corso (cold), then create a course and reload until Allievi (reload). Idle machine (8% CPU, 3 GB free).
pattern: Every build, H1 included, opens in about 1.55-1.65 s on its first context and mostly 2.0-3.3 s afterwards; a fresh browser per sample gives 2.05-2.10 s steadily on the current build. The distribution is bimodal (about 1.55 s or 2.05 s, with 2.6-3.7 s outliers).
conclusion: No reproducible WebKit open regression between H1 and the current production build; the earlier 1 s gap came from this variance and from the dev server, which loads more modules since D3/D4. D4 checkpoints show at most ~0.4 s more on cold median, within the spread. Not pursued further in T1 without a reproducible signal.
devServerNote: Dev-server WebKit cold opens measured 2.2 s at H1 and 3.3-3.8 s now (target-feasibility.json); the browser suite runs on the dev server, so this is a test-harness cost, not a user cost.
